title: FOC march planned for 14 May in N’Djamena; ministry prohibition documented, execution unresolved
reason: The body confirms an intended march that was prohibited; the FOC itself stated it was postponing the march. No executed gathering or attendance is documented in the body sources reviewed. This is a coding exclusion for now, not a claim that no unauthorized action occurred.
notes: Ialtchad says the FOC planned a peaceful march for cost of living and dissolution of CONOREC, then announced postponement to a later date and asked people to go about their activities (lines 11–17). Tchadinfos confirms the ban. No source read verifies any separate or unauthorized gathering on 14 May; retain G002.

title: Ialtchad report ‘La marche du 8 mai violemment dispersée’
reason: Exact body dates the march to 8 May 2021, outside the assigned 2023 month/year; not a candidate event for Chad May 2023.
notes: The search hit appeared in the May 2023 result set but the article body is explicitly dated 9 May 2021 and describes the previous day’s march. This exclusion prevents treating the similarly dated 2021 action as a 2023 event.
